title: 📊 Number of Foreign Students at BSU and their Geography

blocks.text: 📊 Количество Иностранных студентов в БГУ и их география
International students are an important part of our university's academic community.
For the 2024-2025 academic year, BSU is studying 597 foreign citizens. Of these:
28 students — participate in programs International Educational Cooperation (IEC).
🏅 People's Republic of China — 441 people (more than 73% of the total)
The most popular faculties among international students:
Faculty of Social and Psychological Sciences - 36
📌 These data reflect the stable international reputation of BSU and the wide geography of our educational relations - from the CIS countries and Asia to Latin America and the Middle East.
